name: Unseelie Sidhe
startIntroPart1: By Sacred Moon & Sacred Shadow, we shall have victory!
startIntroPart2: The Unseelie Sidhe. Immortal Fae Sovereigns, Lords & Ladies of Air & Darkness.
declaringWar: I swear by sacred Moon & Shadow that blood shall flow!
attacked: Brave but foolish, mortal. Now die...
defeated: We fade back into legend for now, but we shall return...
introduction: We see you, stranger. Are you friend or foe, I wonder?
hateNo: Foolish words, you waste our time.
afterPeace: Much bloodshed shall be avoided, you show wisdom.
tradeRequest: We grant you the honor of this trade offer.
denounced: The accusations of mortals are beneath us.
declaringfriendship: We shall swear an oath of friendship, for now.
